technical illustration · iso kit gallery

Anatomy collection, Part 1

Recreations of the anatomy collection's figures, rebuilt by the iso kit from JSON briefs, part 1. Each assembles on entry; hover or select a part to lift it.

Hash map collisions, pigeonhole buckets

After the anatomy collection. Four pigeonhole buckets numbered 0 to 3 in a row, with a coding machine at the end feeding bucket 3 an incoming letter. Bucket 1 holds one letter; bucket 3 holds a chain of three, the newest highlighted.

Binary search on a lab balance

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric lab balance, pillar, beam and two hung pans: a sample on the left, the accented middle weight on the lower right pan. In front a case of sixteen graded weights; twelve sunk flush, four left in slots 9 to 12, seat 11 empty.

DNS resolution by pneumatic tube

An isometric recreation of the anatomy collection's "DNS resolution" pneumatic tube dispatcher: from an accented resolver on a round desk, tubes of rising height reach the root, com and example.com servers, and a row of cache flags stands for cached answers.

A message queue as a marble run

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric marble run: two producer hoppers sit on the upstream end of one level lane, four marbles wait in order behind an escapement gate, and three consumer drums stand at the lane exit. Hover or arrow keys lift one part.

LRU cache as a bookcase

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric low bookcase with ten lettered slots, A to J, across its front; E to J hold books, A to D are empty. Four books stand on top between bookends, most recent at left; the least recent, Book D, sits over its free slot.

TCP handshake, a mail ropeway

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric mail ropeway between client and server stations. SYN has landed, SYN with ACK flies an ACK pennant home, and the highlighted ACK canister heads out. Client arm reads established, server arm SYN received.

Gradient descent on a contour model

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric contour model of a narrow V valley in stacked boards, two tiers each side of a floor; pins on a thread zigzag down, overshoot across the valley and settle at the accented pin on the floor, beside a rate knob.

Bloom filter as a fruit machine

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric fruit machine: three hash reels recessed in a front window, a coin slot below, a pull lever on a side hub, a rail of sixteen flags on top with three raised, and a payout tray at the front, highlighted.

flex-grow as a bench vise

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric bench vise: a fixed and a moving jaw clamp three blocks in a row. Three equal springs share the free space: one after the grow 1 block, two after the grow 2 block, none after the grow 0 block.

Mark and sweep as a modular synth

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric synth case: cable arrows run from the stack module to modules A and C and from A to B, so all three are marked. Module E, which no cable reaches, is highlighted for the sweep beside a dashed freed slot.

B-tree index, a rotary card file

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric rotary card file: ten card trays pinned round a spoked wheel turned by a crank, above a drawer cabinet. The wheel has brought one tray down onto the reading stop, accented, leaving its slot empty; the other nine wait their turn.

Debounce and throttle recorder

An isometric take on the "Debounce, throttle" music-box recorder from the anatomy collection: five turns of the crank are five calls, the throttle dashpot sets two pins on the disc and the orange debounce dashpot sets one.

A mutex as a tank and key

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric water tank on a stand, filled by two pumps, one at each side, each run by its own controller with a key slot on top. Between them a lock box holds a single accented interlock key. Hover or arrow keys lift one part.
